water_volume_m3.basis: illustrative: log-uniform, +-20% of a single fixed sourced point (m5_specs.md §5.2)

breach_width_m.basis: illustrative: uniform over the Azmi pair widened by 20% (m5_specs.md §5.2) -- identical to the trained design box

failure_time_s.basis: illustrative: uniform over the Azmi pair widened by 20% -- identical to the trained design box

inundated_area_m2.basis: illustrative; low = HIGH-zone area, high = HIGH+POSSIBLE-zone area (docs/impact_outputs.md population convention)

max_depth_m.basis: illustrative; at the breach cell, actually the 5th/95th percentile (see interval_label_p5_p95_not_p10_p90 caveat)

max_velocity_ms.basis: illustrative; 1.6*sqrt(depth) of the breach-cell depth percentiles above

peak_discharge_m3s.basis: illustrative continuity estimate (velocity x depth x channel width) at the breach-cell depth percentiles

arrival_s.basis: illustrative travel-time proxy; low = fastest (P95 depth), high = slowest (P5 depth) -- see far_field_arrival_travel_time_proxy caveat

overall.reason_key: Capped at MODERATE — placeholder inputs (south_lhonak breach_location, dam_height_m are status: placeholder).

provenance.note: 200-sample Monte Carlo ensemble, sampled per m5_specs.md §5.2 exactly: breach_width_m/failure_time_s uniform over the Azmi pair widened by 20% (identical to the trained design box, since that box is itself 'Azmi pair widened by 20%' per §2 -- sampling it again is not a further widening), water_volume_m3 log-uniform at +-20% of one fixed sourced point (narrower than, and normally inside, the training box). Computed by gen_preview_assets.py:gen_confidence_ensemble(); see frontend/src/data/preview/generated/teesta_confidence.json for the full computation. This ensemble's own query_coverage genuinely computes INSIDE (in_box_fraction=1.0) and S/U also compute High, so its only reason for being below HIGH is the placeholder-inputs cap -- the dedicated Low(C: outside trained V_w range) demonstration lives in flood_query_response.teesta.scenario_outside_range.json instead (m5_specs.md §7 acceptance test A6), not in this ensemble's natural sampling. The HIGH-to-POSSIBLE downgrade example is at row 0, col 28 (the breach cell, chainage 0 m): its own 90% interval width genuinely grades U=Low (1.265 m, 108% of the ensemble mean there) per m5_specs.md §6 thresholds -- not a heuristic pick.
